issue.body:
Split from #51. Part of #51. Depends on terminal #263 (51.c) and a separate explicit future operator authorization. This issue is execution-blocked until that authorization is recorded.

## Outcome

After explicit operator authorization, execute the reviewed directory submissions, retain canonical directory IDs/URLs and truthful status, monitor provider outcomes, make bounded corrections, and execute recorded rollback decisions without falsifying submission history.

## Scope

- Operator-authorized submissions to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music, and YouTube.
- Redacted ownership-verification and submission receipts.
- Canonical directory show URL/ID, submission date, account owner, state, and follow-up records.
- Post-submission monitoring, bounded metadata/feed correction, destination-link activation only after live verification, and operator-directed rollback.
- Truthful rejected, pending, accepted, corrected, withdrawn, or unavailable states.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Execution remains blocked until terminal #263 (51.c) and explicit future operator authorization naming the approved submissions.
2. Every submission uses the exact reviewed feed, identity, artwork, rights declarations, and company-controlled account.
3. Canonical provider IDs/URLs and status are retained without credentials, verification codes, or unsupported acceptance claims.
4. Site/destination links are added only after the corresponding destination is live and verified.
5. Corrections and rollback preserve prior submission evidence and do not delete episode source packages.
6. Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable findings before any authorized external action and after final reconciliation.

## Dependencies And Operator Gate

- Terminal #263 (51.c).
- Explicit future operator authorization for each provider submission and public launch action.
- Part of #51.
- Current execution status: BLOCKED ON OPERATOR AUTHORIZATION.

## Non-Goals

- No automatic or unattended submission.
- No action before explicit authorization.
- No credential, recovery-code, or verification-code retention.
- No episode production, hosting redesign, advertising, paid subscription, or monetization.

## Graph

`split_from: #51`; `part_of: #51`; `depends_on: terminal #263 (51.c), explicit operator authorization`; execution blocked until the operator gate is satisfied.
